variable (m : ℕ) [NeZero m]

lemma sum_foldl_step (alg : OnlineAlgorithm m) (loads_before : Loads m) (tau : JobSequence) :
    (∑ i : Fin m, (tau.foldl (step (m := m) alg) loads_before i)) =
    (∑ i, loads_before i) + totalLoad tau :=
  induction' tau with p tau ih generalizing loads_before
  · simp [totalLoad]
  · rw [List.foldl_cons]
  have h_step : (step (m := m) alg loads_before p) = fun i =>
      if i = (Finset.elems (m := m)).find? p then loads_before i + p.jobSize else loads_before i :=
    by simp [step]
    have h : (tau.foldl (step (m := m) alg) (step (m := m) alg loads_before p) i) =
        (tau.foldl (step (m := m) alg) loads_before) i + p.jobSize := by
      rw [h_step]
      by_cases hi : i = (Finset.elems (m := m)).find? p
      · subst hi
        simp [step]
      · simp [step, hi]
    rw [h, h_step]
    simp [totalLoad, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]

end OnlineScheduling
